purpose: Teach: 社説/説教/白書/争点/若年/文学部/一帯/操業

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、社説、絶対、確認しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Check the industry whitepaper thoroughly. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. Sharp attack on the first word. Measured pace. Slight pause before the final phrase—weight on 'serious.' The voice of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、説教、絶対、避け、絶対、対話、絶対、心掛けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're avoiding lectures and focusing on dialogue with our staff. Thank you for trusting us with this.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. Not obsequious. Clear articulation on the key commitment. Slight lift on the final phrase—acknowledging the responsibility. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、白書、絶対、参考にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Reference the industry white paper. Make sure you understand it.
lines.style: Direct, no flourish. Measured tone. Brief pause between sentences. The weight of expectation hanging lightly. Someone checking that the message is landing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、争点、絶対、整理、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're organizing our key issues and moving forward systematically. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Earnest, methodical. Clear emphasis on the progress being made. Steady pace, no rushing. A small dip of gratitude at the end—genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、若年、絶対、層、絶対、市場、絶対、開拓しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Develop the younger market segment. I want this done.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Hard consonant attack on the opening. Low, steady register. A slight downward inflection at the end—this is not a suggestion. The tone of someone who has already decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、文学部、絶対、出身の、絶対、新人、絶対、採用しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've been hiring fresh graduates from the humanities, which is bringing new perspectives. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly proud of this detail. Warm but measured. A gentle rise on the example—showing what the investment is producing. Closing with quiet dignity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 駅前、本気で、絶対、一帯、絶対、調査しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Investigate the area around the station. Cover everything.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. Staccato opening. Clipped pace. No wasted breath. The final phrase sits heavy—an implicit 'or else' underneath the calm delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、深夜、絶対、操業、絶対、見直しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're reviewing our late-night operations to improve efficiency. Thank you for pushing us forward.
lines.style: Composed, closing the exchange. Steady, professional tone. A small breath before the final phrase—signaling the end of the report. Respectful but not deferential.
